## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The PR title follows `Add <Name> to <chapter number>`.
- [ ] The entry uses the format `- [Name](URL) - Description ending with a period.`
- [ ] The link is the canonical URL and it works.
- [ ] The resource is not already listed, and it is in the single most specific chapter.
- [ ] Open-source projects: usable license, not archived, commits within 12 months (unless important frozen benchmark/paper).
- [ ] Not marketing, rebate, paid-signal, or "guaranteed return" content.
- [ ] I updated both `README.md` and `README.zh-CN.md` (or explained below why not).
- [ ] No star counts, version numbers, or marketing language.
